triples.tail_surface: Fill the pump with the liquid to be handled through the filling plug at the pump front until the liquid starts to overflow
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 通过泵前部注液塞向泵内注入输送液体直至溢出
triples.evidence_text: Fill the pump with the liquid to be handled through the filling plug at the pump front until the liquid starts to overflow.

triples.tail_surface: the appropriate pressure of the flushing liquid must be set. This pressure must be 1,5 bar higher than the pressure at the impeller hub
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 设定冲洗液适当压力，该压力须比叶轮轮毂处压力高1.5 bar
triples.evidence_text: When flushing a double mechanical seal (version MD1), the appropriate pressure of the flushing liquid must be set. This pressure must be 1,5 bar higher than the pressure at the impeller hub.

triples.tail_surface: Open any pressure cut-off entirely... it is necessary that the air escapes unobstructed and without any back pressure in the discharge pipe
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 全开压力切断阀，确保空气在排出管路中无阻碍且无背压地排出
triples.evidence_text: Open any pressure cut-off entirely. During the self-priming phase, it is necessary that the air escapes unobstructed and without any back pressure in the discharge pipe.

triples.tail_surface: properly screened off by the guard
triples.evidence_text: Make sure that when a pump is running, rotating parts are always properly screened off by the guard!

triples.tail_surface: The pump should never run dry
triples.evidence_text: The pump should never run dry.

triples.tail_surface: Check whether the absolute inlet pressure is sufficient, to prevent vaporization in the pump
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查绝对入口压力是否充足以防止泵内汽化
triples.evidence_text: Check whether the absolute inlet pressure is sufficient, to prevent vaporization in the pump.

triples.tail_canonical_zh: 检查绝对入口压力是否充足
triples.evidence_text: Check whether the absolute inlet pressure is sufficient, to prevent vaporization in the pump.

triples.tail_surface: Check whether the pressure difference between suction and delivery side corresponds with the specifications of the pump's duty point

triples.evidence_text: Check whether the pressure difference between suction and delivery side corresponds with the specifications of the pump's duty point.
